test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To call the shots
solution:
The correct answer is **"to have control"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"To call the shots"** is an idiom that means to have control of something.
 
• Look at the following examples:
 
 
• Manu is the captain of this team, he will **call the shots **during the game.
 
• The lieutenant is the one who will **call the shots** during the war.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is: *to have control*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Following idioms are similar to **"to call the shots"**

 
 
• **be in the driving seat**
 
• **be in the saddle.**
 
• **pull the strings.**
 
• **be in control.**
